pin_levels.block: assets[*].digest, over assets[*].span_rule — build_assets REFUSES to re-pin a changed block without repin, and load_assets REFUSES THE RUN when the asset on disk disagrees with this lock
pin_levels.section: assets[*].section_digest, over assets[*].section_span_rule — build_assets REPORTS a change and never refuses
pin_levels.whole-file: source_digest, over source_digest_span_rule — recorded as provenance, enforced nowhere

boundary_rule: exactly-one section heading; section ends at the next line starting with '#'; the nth fenced block within it; both fence lines and the newline terminating the opening fence line excluded; nothing trimmed or normalised beyond BOM-strip and CRLF->LF

rubric.txt.section_span_rule: section:## 1.6 THE INJECTED RUBRIC — literal text:heading-any-level
rubric.txt.role: row 3 of the packet — the rubric, injected verbatim (I1)

preamble_envelope.txt.role: row 1 of the packet — the six top-level keys (I3)

preamble_finding.txt.role: row 1 of the packet — the ten per-finding keys (I3)
